name: Naspers
note: South African consumer-internet group with its primary listing on the Johannesburg Stock Exchange (NPN). Keeromstraat 30 Beleggings and Naspers Beleggings hold A shares that together control more than 50% of the voting rights (naspers.com, Group structure). Its annual financial statements 2026 (https://www.naspers.com/~/media/Files/N/Naspers-Corp-V2/results-reports-and-events-archive/latest-results/fy-2026/naspers-annual-financial-statements-2026.pdf) list the Public Investment Corporation with 22.53% of the N ordinary shares at 31 March 2026, and give the group's effective interest in Prosus as 43.4% and in Good BidCo B.V. (GoodHabitz) as 30.44%.
